subject.title: [Bug]: openai-completions fallback candidate is selected, but fallback does not complete successfully through an OpenAI-compatible proxy

question: Should this issue wait for a current-main proxy request/response capture, add fallback diagnostics first, or introduce a strict-minimal `openai-completions` compatibility mode/config surface now?
rationale: Current source shows several plausible request-shape incompatibilities, but adding a new mode or config surface without the failing payload could expand provider behavior unnecessarily.

options.title: Require proxy capture first
options.body: Keep the issue open until a reporter or maintainer captures the outbound request body plus proxy status/body on current main, then implement the narrowest proven fix.

options.title: Improve diagnostics first
options.body: Add safer fallback diagnostics around request-shape incompatibilities without adding a strict-minimal mode yet.

options.title: Design strict-minimal mode
options.body: Accept new provider/model compatibility surface for bare Chat Completions payloads before a specific incompatible field is proven.

recommendation.title: Require proxy capture first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open until a reporter or maintainer captures the outbound request body plus proxy status/body on current main, then implement the narrowest proven fix.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the live assignee for the issue and is the clearest current owner for deciding whether to wait for proof or choose a product direction.
